hook: One actuary's warning went unheard. Then $542 billion vanished.

instagram.caption:
One actuary's warning went unheard. Then $542 billion vanished.

David Li published one paper in 2000. It let banks price bundles of mortgages with a single number — the correlation rho.

Fit it on calm years and it looks safe. In a crash, it snaps to one.

In 2005 Li himself said very few people understood the model. The market kept growing. The formula still runs on Wall Street.

Save this for the next time someone trusts one number.
